storyline_causality_quote: In some calls made through Meta’s AI agent, “Muse,” trained human contract workers—not AI—placed the calls.
entertainment_quote: It was like a human entering halfway through a play in which AI was the star.
comprehension_quote: For users, knowing who they are speaking with is important information: it can shape what they decide to talk about.
thinness_quote: Meta employees also worried that a user’s sensitive information might be shared by accident with contract staff at a call center.
